prompt: The Sikh empire's capital at the time of the Battle of Sobraon came under the rule of the British Crown in what year?
answer: The Sikh Empire’s capital was **Lahore**. It came under British control when the Punjab was annexed in **1849**, following the Second Anglo-Sikh War. (Direct Crown administration replaced East India Company rule in **1858**.)
